pergunta: What is the minimum car mass, before Nominal Tyre Mass, during Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying sessions in the 2026 F1 Technical Regulations?
resposta_gerada: According to Article C4.1 of the 2026 F1 Technical Regulations, during Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying sessions, the Minimum Mass is 726kg plus the Nominal Tyre Mass. Therefore, the minimum car mass, before Nominal Tyre Mass, during these sessions is 726kg.

pergunta: How many points does the winner of a full-distance Grand Prix receive under the 2026 General Regulations?
resposta_gerada: According to Article 2.1.3 of the 2026 FIA Formula One World Championship Technical and Sporting Regulations, the winner of a full-distance Grand Prix receives 25 points.

pergunta: What is the maximum number of team personnel allowed access to the Parc Fermé area per F1 Car, and for what purpose?
resposta_gerada: According to Article 22.4 of the FIA F1 2026 Technical Regulations, a maximum of three (3) team personnel per F1 Car will be permitted access to the Parc Fermé area for the sole purpose of fitting cooling fans and undertaking any work required by those officials charged with supervision of parc fermé.

pergunta: What percentage of the race winner's completed laps must a car have covered to be classified at the end of a race?
resposta_gerada: According to section 3.3b, a car must have covered at least 90% of the number of laps completed by the winner (rounded down to the nearest whole number of laps) to be classified at the end of a race.

pergunta: What is the Cost Cap amount, in US Dollars, for a Full Year Financial Regulations Reporting Period in which 24 or fewer Competitions take place?
resposta_gerada: The Cost Cap amount, in US Dollars, for a Full Year Financial Regulations Reporting Period in which 24 or fewer Competitions take place is $215,000,000 adjusted, if applicable, for Indexation.

pergunta: What happened during the 2024 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix?
resposta_gerada: Durante o Grande Prêmio da Abu Dhabi de 2024, Lando Norris venceu a corrida para garantir ao McLaren seu primeiro título de construtores desde 1998.
